title: plugyard Chargerfile
description: One kind of charger: its identity, connectors and default configuration. Many chargers can be made from one Chargerfile.

vendor.description: Sent as chargePointVendor in BootNotification. At most 20 characters.

model.description: Sent as chargePointModel in BootNotification. At most 20 characters.

firmware.description: Sent as firmwareVersion in BootNotification. At most 50 characters.

connectors.description: The charger's connectors, numbered from 1 in order.

id.description: The connector number: 1 for the first, 2 for the second, and so on.

type.description: The plug type, such as CCS2, CHAdeMO or Type2. It is for your own reading; the CSMS does not see it.

maxPower.description: The most power the connector delivers, such as 50kW or 7.4kW.

config.description: Default values of OCPP configuration keys, such as HeartbeatInterval. The CSMS can read them and change the ones that are not read-only.

dataTransfer.description: Vendor IDs whose DataTransfer requests from the CSMS are answered Accepted.

voltage.description: The supply voltage in volts. With phases, it turns a charging profile limit in amps into power. Default 230.

phases.description: The number of phases of the supply. Default 3.

onEvFull.description: What happens when the EV is full. stop: end the transaction. suspend: report SuspendedEV and keep it open. Default stop.

startOn.description: What starts a transaction. tap: a tag is presented. plug: plugging in, using startTag. Default tap.

startTag.description: The idTag used when startOn is plug. At most 20 characters.
